title: The Night Circus
description: A mysterious black-and-white circus that only opens at night hides a magical duel between two young illusionists bound to compete.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: A schoolteacher wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory and slowly realises he is humanity's last shot at saving the Sun.

title: Pachinko
description: Four generations of a Korean family build a life in Japan across the twentieth century, holding on to dignity amid prejudice.

title: The Midnight Library
description: Between life and death sits a library where every book lets Nora try one of the lives she might have lived.

title: Circe
description: The banished witch of Greek myth tells her own story of exile, power and the gods and mortals who cross her island.

title: Educated
description: Raised in the Idaho mountains without schooling, Tara teaches herself enough to reach university and a world beyond her family.

title: Klara and the Sun
description: An Artificial Friend watches the world from a shop window and learns what it might mean to love the child she is chosen for.

title: The Thursday Murder Club
description: Four retirees who meet weekly to discuss cold cases find themselves with a very fresh murder on their doorstep.

title: Atomic Habits
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny, compounding one-percent changes.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
description: Two childhood friends become video-game design partners, and their thirty-year collaboration tests love, art and loyalty.

title: The Hobbit
description: Comfort-loving Bilbo Baggins is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim a mountain guarded by a dragon.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
description: A sweeping look at how Homo sapiens went from foragers to the rulers of the planet, and the stories that bind us together.

title: Crying in H Mart
description: The Japanese Breakfast musician remembers her Korean mother through food, grief and the search for identity.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
description: A reclusive Hollywood icon finally tells the truth about her glamorous, scandalous life to an unknown young journalist.

title: Good Omens
description: An angel and a demon who have grown fond of Earth team up to stop the Apocalypse, which is scheduled for next Saturday.

title: Dune
description: On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is drawn into a war over the most valuable substance in the universe.

title: Before the Coffee Gets Cold
description: In a tiny Tokyo cafe, customers can travel back in time, but only until their coffee goes cold.

title: The Silent Patient
description: A famous painter shoots her husband and never speaks again, until a psychotherapist becomes obsessed with uncovering why.

title: Little Women
description: The four March sisters grow up through hardship, ambition and friendship in Civil War-era New England.

title: Piranesi
description: Piranesi lives in an endless House of halls and tides, cataloguing its statues, until clues suggest the world is not what it seems.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: A gifted young man grows into the most notorious wizard his world has known, telling the true story behind his own legend.

title: Normal People
description: Two Irish teenagers circle each other through school and university, pulled together and apart over the years.

title: Gone Girl
description: When Amy disappears on her fifth wedding anniversary, her husband becomes the prime suspect in a case full of twists.

title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
description: Queens, mages and dragon riders across a divided world must set aside old enmities before an ancient wyrm wakes.

title: A Little Life
description: Four college friends make their way in New York, their bond tested by the buried trauma one of them carries.

title: The Song of Achilles
description: The Trojan War retold through the tender, doomed love between the warrior Achilles and the exiled prince Patroclus.

title: Children of Time
description: The last remnants of humanity flee a dying Earth toward a terraformed world that has evolved its own uplifted civilisation.

title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
description: A by-the-book caseworker is sent to a remote orphanage of magical children and discovers a home he never expected.

title: Born a Crime
description: The comedian recounts growing up mixed-race in apartheid and post-apartheid South Africa, held together by a fearless mother.

title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle
description: An ordinary man's search for his missing cat, then his wife, pulls him into a surreal Tokyo of wells, dreams and strangers.
